messages.subject: possible documentation issues
parts:
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/guides.html: the first few plots look
identical. There is a comment before the 2nd one that "All these
examples below have a same effect." But should all the examples below
match the example above? At any rate, I'd prefer to see examples of how
the guide specification changes things. Further down the page there are
such examples.

http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/guide_legend.html has similar issues.
